messages.subject: no graph, bibliography error
parts:
Dear all,

I've constructed two sample document which are shorter version of my article.

I'm using terminal in Ubuntu for firstly running sample.Rnw and than sample tex.

When I used pdfatex, it works.

But when I use latex sample.tex, bibtex sample, latex sample.tex, latex sample.tex 
there is no graph and no bibliography

The pdflatex  gives the same error for the longer version of these short documents.

I'm new in knitr and latex,

if you have time and have look at these very short documents I'd appreciated.

Bests,
Niklas

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] no graph, bibliography error
parts:
You are using the PNG device, and latex does not support PNG (there
might be packages which I do not know); pdflatex supports PNG images.

My suggestion to you is to spend _a few years_ learning LaTeX before
using it with knitr, otherwise you can start with R Markdown
(http://yihui.name/knitr/demo/minimal/). Of course it does not take
years to be able to answer your question below, but I'm sure you will
have tons of questions later since you do not seem to know the
difference between latex and pdflatex. I'm still learning LaTeX after
8 years of using it. It is worth the efforts but may sound scary to
some users. I just do not want to answer pure LaTeX questions; it is
too much burden for me.

Back to your question: if you have to use latex at all (it is rare
nowadays), you have to use eps images, which corresponds to
dev='postscript' in knitr. But pdflatex does not support eps...

Regards,
Yihui
